I read a few pages before turning off the light.

A low-effort task that gave a small sense of order.
I have a Thursday morning knee replacement follow-up where the surgeon needs to see my knee bend through its full range without swelling.
That's a specific, non-negotiable requirement.

A quick check avoids taking something past its date.
I tried a guided breathing exercise for a few minutes.
A few minutes is enough to see if it helps.
I skimmed a wellness article shared by a coworker.
Passive reading can still be useful context.
